item.title: The Summer of 1993: My Father and Me in Beidaihe
item.description: A photograph taken around June 1993 shows me at fifteen beside my forty-two-year-old father in Beidaihe. Thirty-three years later, I realize he was younger then than I am now.

item.title: A Helping Hand
item.description: An elderly woman asking for directions in Chengde made me notice the pavements, barriers and tactile paths I usually hurry past, and remember that all of us will grow old.

item.title: A Three-Yuan Car Wash—and Why the Math Actually Works
item.description: A supermarket car-wash benefit offers a glimpse into why retailers sometimes provide services that make little sense as standalone businesses.
